title: Sr Manager - Decision Intelligence
jobDescription: Job Description About Busuu Busuu is one of the world's leading language-learning platforms, part of Chegg. We help over 100 million learners build language skills that change their lives — through apps, web, and now an AI-first product experience. We operate across consumer (B2C) and business (B2B/enterprise) markets in over 100 countries . About Decision Intelligence Decision Intelligence (DI) is the central capability that makes the business measurable, governed, and trusted. It spans data insights and analytics across the organization, operating through three layers: analytics partners embedded in business teams, a central hub that owns standards, metrics architecture, experimentation, and governance, and a platform layer (Data Engineering) that builds the infrastructure. DI does not govern business decisions — it governs the standards that make those decisions trustworthy and evidence-based. We don't build dashboards on request; we build the foundations teams build on. We work hybrid with team members across India, the UK, and the EU. The Role You are the operational backbone of Busuu's Decision Intelligence function. As Head of Decision Intelligence, you anchor business-wide strategic intelligence, run the hub day-to-day, manage and develop analytics leaders as a player-coach, and own the methodology behind Busuu's weekly business performance reporting and monthly leadership reviews. You operate as a player-coach: you lead capability work in the hub, grow direct reports across the organization, and continue to contribute hands-on to strategic analytics work. You partner with senior analytics stakeholders on metrics architecture and strategy, with the Director on hub direction, and with business leaders on analytics-driven narratives. The role is the connective tissue of the function — turning measurement into operating decisions across the business. It is also a role with a clear trajectory: the right person grows into broader strategic leadership scope over time as the function scales. Key Responsibilities Business-wide strategic owner — anchor cross-functional business narrative, deep-dives, and performance readouts. Be the credible analytics voice in leadership forums and key business meetings. Player-coach for direct reports — Develop 3-4 analytics leaders on craft, level progression, and strategic partnership capability. Balance coaching and mentorship with your own hands-on strategic analytics contributions. Weekly business performance reporting — design, narrative arc, and analytical integrity of weekly business performance summaries. Monthly leadership review architecture — partner with senior analytics stakeholders on monthly business review structure; you own the weekly-to-monthly narrative connection. Experimentation standards — co-build testing rigor and best practices across the organization. Hub operations — day-to-day leadership of the analytics hub as the synthesis layer that makes cross-functional signals usable for executive decisions. Metrics architecture co-ownership — co-own metrics definition and architecture with senior analytics partners. Business performance deep-dives — cross-functional lens, working with your team on methodology and insights. Strategic planning and forecasting — the senior analytics voice on business strategy, OKR setting, and opportunity sizing. What We Are Looking For Required 10+ years experience in analytics, business intelligence, strategy, or consulting at meaningful scale — ideally with hands-on analytical depth and people leadership combined. Demonstrated player-coach experience — managing 3+ analysts or data scientists while continuing to contribute as a senior individual contributor to strategic work. Comfortable in both leadership and hands-on analytical work. Strong commercial instinct — you understand how analytics maps to business outcomes (revenue, retention, lifetime value, unit economics, conversion). Strategic narrative skill — you translate quantitative measurement into executive-grade communication that drives decisions, not just describes them. Senior stakeholder influence — comfortable operating with Directors, VPs, and General Managers. Diplomatic but direct. Excellent SQL and fluency with BI tooling (Tableau, Looker, Metabase, or equivalent). Working knowledge of semantic-layer thinking (dbt, Cube, LookML, or equivalent). Experience designing or owning a weekly business performance reporting cadence and a monthly business review architecture. Comfort working in a hybrid team across time zones — explicit overlap with London and EU as a known feature of the role. Preferred B2C subscription + B2B SaaS exposure — comfortable thinking about both segments and weaving them together. EdTech context. AI and transformation measurement experience. Prior team-building or hiring track record — bringing in talent, growing analysts, and building team-level capability. Demonstrated growth trajectory — you've taken on expanded scope as you've delivered. The function is scaling; the right person will too. Familiarity with analytics operating models, data-driven decision practices, or building analytics functions in fast-moving environments. Competencies Expected at this Level Strategic Thinking — plans strategy for team and projects (3-9 month horizon); anticipates issues; plans for scalability; contributes to function-level direction. Communication & Leadership — tactical day-to-day team communication; conflict resolution; makes sound talent decisions (hires, performance, promotions); coaches and develops with compassion; fosters collaboration; influences senior stakeholders. Critical Thinking — prioritizes given impact and effort; identifies and asks tough questions; coaches reports on data-driven decision-making. Accountability — drives repeatable results at team and project level; provides clear ownership; knows when to escalate; fully committed to objectives. Analytics Architecture and Design — coaches team on measurement design; sets architectural standards; owns system-level measurement conversations with key stakeholders. Cross-functional Pattern Recognition — drives conversation across teams on shared patterns; coaches team members to identify and surface patterns; weaves signals into coherent narrative. How We Work Decision Intelligence is deliberately small and high-leverage. We are pragmatic about trade-offs, opinionated about standards, and committed to evidence over opinion. The hub is the connective layer between business teams and Executive Leadership — and as Head of Decision Intelligence, you are the connective tissue of that layer. The function is scaling as part of broader business evolution at Busuu. The right person in this role will grow with it — expanding scope over time as the function matures. We work hybrid across India, the UK, and the EU. The role is India-based with explicit time-zone bridging with EU/UK. What is Chegg? An ‘always on’ digital learning platform. Chegg puts students first…Everything we build in this company is student-focused, making us the leading student-first connected learning platform. Chegg strives to improve the overall return on investment in education by helping students learn more in less time and at a lower cost. This is achieved by providing students a multitude of educational tools from affordable textbook rentals to Chegg Study which supplements their learning through 24/7 tutor access, step-by-step help with questions, and more. Chegg is a publicly-held company based in Santa Clara, California and trades on the NYSE under the symbol CHGG.

title: Manager - UK Accounting

The ideal candidate will have strong technical accounting expertise in US GAAP and IFRS, hands-on experience preparing UK GAAP financial statements, and a proven track record of managing accounting processes in a fast-paced environment. This role will work closely with cross-functional teams and leadership to ensure accurate financial reporting, compliance, and process improvements. Financial Reporting & Accounting • Manage and oversee month-end and year-end close processes to ensure timely and accurate reporting. • Prepare and review financial statements in compliance with UK GAAP. • Ensure accounting activities comply with US GAAP and IFRS requirements. • Support statutory reporting, external audits, and regulatory compliance activities. • Maintain strong internal controls and accounting policies across processes. Team & Stakeholder Management • Mentor and guide team members while fostering a collaborative work environment. • Partner with finance leadership and cross-functional stakeholders on accounting and reporting matters. • Support transition and stabilization activities for new accounting processes or entities. Qualifications & Experience • ACCA qualification is must. • Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, or related field. • 6–10+ years of progressive accounting experience. • Strong knowledge of US GAAP, IFRS, UK GAAP financial statement preparation • Exposure to ERP systems like Netsuite, Blackline, Coupa. • Hands-on experience managing month-end close processes. • Experience in revenue accounting and revenue recognition. • Experience supporting statutory audits and financial reporting. • Strong analytical, organizational, and • problem-solving skills. • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. title: Senior Software Engineer - Model Training & AI Evals
jobDescription: Job Description ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our AI team at the intersection of evaluation science, post-training, and foundation model development. You will own our end-to-end eval and benchmarking infrastructure — the critical feedback loop that drives every major model improvement — while contributing hands-on to post-training pipelines for industry-specific vertical foundation models. This role is ideal for someone who has worked directly inside an LLM lab and understands what rigorous evaluation looks like at scale: designing the taxonomy of skills being measured, identifying failure modes, engineering synthetic data to close capability gaps, and translating eval signals into actionable training decisions. WHAT YOU'LL DO Evaluation & Benchmarking Design and own task-level evaluation frameworks for LLM agents and base models, covering multi-step reasoning, tool/API use, instruction following, and domain knowledge — grounded in real user failure modes rather than off-the-shelf benchmark suites. Build comparative benchmarking pipelines to assess leading frontier models (GPT-4o, Gemini, Claude, Llama, Mistral, etc.) against each other and against internal models, with structured analysis of where each model family fails, regresses, or excels across subjects, topics, and task types. Produce capability gap reports that quantify performance deltas across dimensions such as subject-matter accuracy, reasoning depth, factual consistency, and refusal behaviour. Track model version regressions across provider releases to maintain a living competitive intelligence benchmark. Develop domain-specific benchmarks tailored to vertical use-cases (e.g., STEM tutoring, legal, finance, healthcare) — including problem taxonomy design, rubric definition, and inter-annotator agreement pipelines. Define and drive synthetic data generation strategies to systematically address model shortcomings in specific subjects, topics, and skill areas: Identify low-performance clusters from eval results and translate them into targeted data generation prompts and pipelines. Design LLM-assisted pipelines for generating high-quality, diverse, and verifiable synthetic training and evaluation data at scale. Validate synthetic data quality through auto-eval, human review, and downstream model performance lift experiments. Build automated regression suites integrated into CI/CD workflows to detect capability degradation across fine-tuning runs and model updates. Partner with product, curriculum, and research teams to translate eval insights into prioritized post-training and data flywheel decisions. Post-Training & Fine-Tuning Lead or directly contribute to SFT, RLHF, RLAIF, and DPO training runs on industry-specific vertical foundation models — from dataset design through training execution and eval-gated release. Curate and engineer high-quality instruction-tuning and preference datasets for domain adaptation, with hands-on experience distinguishing signal from noise in annotation pipelines. Define data quality criteria, rejection sampling strategies, and deduplication pipelines for SFT corpora. Design preference pair construction methodologies and reward model training setups grounded in domain-specific quality rubrics. Implement and experiment with alignment techniques including reward modelling, process reward models (PRMs), and constitutional/RLAIF approaches. Run ablation studies and controlled experiments to attribute model behaviour changes to specific data or training interventions — not just report final numbers. Contribute to continual pre-training and domain-adaptive fine-tuning pipelines for vertical models, including domain data sourcing, mixing strategies, and curriculum design. Infrastructure & Tooling Build scalable eval pipelines that run automatically on every training checkpoint and integrate into CI/CD for continuous model quality tracking. Maintain model cards, eval leaderboards, and internal dashboards providing visibility across experiments for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ensure reproducibility through rigorous experiment tracking (W&B, MLflow, or equivalent), versioned datasets, and documented training configs. WHO YOU ARE Required 5+ years of ML/AI engineering experience, with at least 2–3 years focused on large language models. Lab pedigree: Direct, hands-on experience at an LLM lab, AI research organization, or equivalent frontier AI team — you have shipped models, not just called APIs. Familiarity with the full model lifecycle: pre-training data, post-training alignment, eval, and production deployment. Deep practical expertise in post-training methods: SFT, RLHF, RLAIF, DPO, PPO — from dataset construction through training and eval-gated release. Experience with reward modeling, preference data curation, and quality control for alignment pipelines. Demonstrated experience designing LLM evaluation frameworks beyond standard benchmarks — including task-level evals for agentic or multi-step workflows. Hands-on experience building synthetic data generation pipelines to address specific model capability gaps: Designing targeted generation prompts based on eval failure analysis. Validating synthetic data quality through downstream model performance experiments. Proven track record of comparative benchmarking across leading foundation models, with structured analysis of capability shortcomings by subject, skill, or task type. Experience training or fine-tuning vertical/industry-specific foundation models — domain data curation, continual pre-training, or domain-adaptive SFT. Strong software engineering fundamentals: Python, PyTorch or JAX, distributed training Preferred Publications or applied research contributions in LLM evaluation, alignment, or post-training. Experience with multi-modal models or agents with external tool/API use. Exposure to red-teaming, adversarial evaluation, or safety benchmarking. Model distillation, speculative decoding, or inference optimization experience. Prior experience in an education, STEM, legal, biomedical, or enterprise software vertical. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 30 Days Fully onboarded into training infra and eval repos. Running existing benchmarks end-to-end and producing a written gap analysis identifying missing coverage. 60 Days Shipped at least one new domain-specific benchmark and one synthetic data generation pipeline addressing a known model gap. CI-integrated eval running on every checkpoint. 3 Months Standardize model evaluation framework for foundation models. Own golden dataset strategies for fine-tuning with measurable subject-accuracy gains 6 Months Recognized internally as the authority on model quality and competitive benchmarking. Eval insights are directly driving roadmap prioritization. Why do we exist? Students are working harder than ever before to stabilize their future.
